metadata.description: Black Box Safety internal Claude plugins — site operations, state sales, marketing, and AI foundations.

plugins.name: bbs-website
plugins.description: Maintain the BBS website end to end — price list to live product page. Catalog intake and import, contract pricing, variant families, enrichment, storefront pages, quote-bot lane tuning, QA and cross-sell.

plugins.name: bbs-sales
plugins.description: The California state book, end to end: work the territory that creates the demand, then run the quote desk it feeds. Territory: segment a book into a dated call list, time it to the state budget calendar, brief an agency and a site visit, pressure-test the brief, and write the weekly sales report; Sal plans territory launches and Brenda runs DGS blanket purchase orders. Quote desk: log an inbound RFQ, pull items out of whatever the agency sent (DWR RFQ PDF, Grainger cart, or a screenshot), check DGS BPO eligibility, price it through the Grainger MCP or vendor sourcing, build the customer quote in the Business Central print layout, and fill the CDCR and CA compliance packets. Plus Grainger promo pages. Item cards: enter new products into Business Central with a vendor, a sourced cost and the house posting groups, after the rep approves a review sheet by name (bc-item-entry).

plugins.name: bbs-marketing
plugins.description: Marketing material for reps: open a piece, draft a one-page sales document, draft a campaign email, check a logo against the rights ledger, and find a prior brochure or deck. Approved wording lives in the claims registry. A human sends.

plugins.name: bbs-back-office
plugins.description: What happens after the bid is won: read the truth out of Business Central. Where an order stands, what a vendor still owes us, what a problem order actually needs, and what the deal earned once Grainger rebates are applied.

plugins.name: bbs-foundations
plugins.description: Company-wide AI foundations: the BBS way to write CLAUDE.md files (BBSClaudeMDForge), the doctrine every skill inherits, the shared company facts, systems of record, and certification rules that keep every repo and customer folder consistent, and order reconciliation — diagnosing and resolving problems on orders already placed.

plugins.name: bbs-claude-coach
plugins.description: Teaches BBS teammates how Claude works here and helps them start any overlapping job confidently — what skills, commands, plugins, and connectors are; how to extend the toolkit; the two safety rails without control culture. Commands: /bbs-what-can-i-do, /bbs-start, /bbs-explain-claude.

plugins.name: bbs-tools
plugins.description: Claude Code only: the bbs-fill launcher, the one way Claude runs BBS's vetted form and quote scripts without auto mode stopping it. Managed settings allow Bash(bbs-fill *); the launcher runs only allow-listed scripts from the installed bbs-sales plugin, with a fixed interpreter.

plugins.name: agent-team
plugins.description: Run a long program with a team of Claude agents. roster-builder charters named, lane-owned agents grounded in the real repos; project-steward is the one planner that sequences work, writes fenced session charters, runs a bounded review loop, keeps the decision and carry-forward ledgers, and hands off. Company-neutral: every program noun lives in the adopter's docs/pm/PROGRAM-PROFILE.md.

plugins.name: claudeforge
plugins.description: Pinned external dependency of bbs-foundations: the generic CLAUDE.md engine (150-line cap, @path chaining, /enhance-claude-md, /sync-claude-md, drift/link/dependency audits). BBS fork of alirezarezvani/ClaudeForge; bbs-claude-md-forge supplies the BBS doctrine on top of it.

plugins.name: impeccable
plugins.description: Pinned external design skill for anything with a frontend: /impeccable polish, audit, critique, typeset, layout, and 61 deterministic anti-pattern detector rules. Used on customer-facing HTML (dossiers, landing pages, quote bot, storefront). BBS fork of pbakaus/impeccable (v4.3.1); update by syncing the fork from upstream. git-subdir fetches only the fork's plugin/ folder (2.2 MB; the whole repo plus its Node install was 639 MB and failed on rep laptops). The hooks block replaces the plugin's own PostToolUse and Stop hooks with no-ops: those run the impeccable engine on every edit, and the engine's launcher downloads its binary from upstream pbakaus/impeccable releases on first run, outside this pin. The skill itself still runs the engine when a rep invokes /impeccable, as it did before.

plugins.name: superpowers-chrome
plugins.description: Commons: drives the rep's real Chrome over the DevTools protocol (logged-in sessions, product research on distributor and agency sites). Skill mode needs Node.js (bbs-setup.ps1 installs it). Upstream self-labels beta. Pin, release model, cadence and provenance: docs/COMMONS.md.

plugins.name: caveman
plugins.description: Commons: terse output mode (/caveman lite|full|ultra) that cuts roughly two-thirds of output tokens while keeping technical content exact. Opt-in per session; ruled 2026-09-13. The skills: list records which skills BBS intends reps to receive — on Claude Code 2.1.273 the loader treats it as additive rather than restrictive, so the whole tree still registers. v2.7.0 is taken for a Windows path fix in the session hooks. Release model, cadence, provenance, the license split and the open items: docs/COMMONS.md.

plugins.name: document-skills
plugins.description: Commons: Anthropic's official document skills — Word (tracked changes, comments), PDF (extract, merge, fill, annotate), Excel (formulas, charts), PowerPoint (build with pptxgenjs, read with markitdown). RFQ worksheets, bid PDFs, price lists, and the deck assembly step bbs-deck-voice hands off to. The skills: list records intent only; on Claude Code 2.1.273 the loader treats it as additive rather than restrictive, so the whole anthropics/skills tree registers. Pin, release model and the LibreOffice caveat: docs/COMMONS.md.

plugins.name: taste-skill
plugins.description: Commons, maintainer-tier (not a rep default): art direction for websites, product pages, dashboards and app screens, with a real-browser inspector. One skill, design-taste-frontend; no hooks, commands or agents. Its scripts query public open-image collections (no API key) and drive a local Chrome or Edge. Developer- and designer-aimed, and it overlaps impeccable and frontend-design, so it is not for the rep fleet. Pin, release model, cadence, provenance and the open bootstrap question: docs/COMMONS.md.
